title: Milanese embassy at Buda, 1489-90: Maffeo da Treviglio's cipher (ASMi Sforzesco 642/650)

steps.what: Somogyi 2016 key and cipher/clear pairs; Vestigia API and DECODE records located; clear copies found for R1155 and R1147.
Segmentation and agent transcription of R1098, 267 and 2831 p. 1 strips; several agents lost to the rate limit.
Somogyi's numbers follow first occurrence in 267, so aligning 267 with its clear extract 268 pins glyphs to values; 267 decodes almost verbatim.
R1098 read in gist, all ten cipher lines.
R1098 ll. 7-10 restate the letter's clear page 2.
2831 ll. 1-2 reproduce Somogyi's printed decipherment exactly.
22 Nov 1489 letter read across all four pages, new sign values gained along the way.
Framing corrected: 'nobody had deciphered' becomes 'no published decipherment'; Somogyi held the key and printed a specimen of the letter.

Reclassified from 'read' to 'read in part': no measured share of signs read; page 3 of the 1489 letter after l. 19 read only in patches (about a third of its words), four signs unvalued, R1098 ll. 5, 6, 9 short groups open. NOTES gain Remaining gaps and Escalation sections; next step is a full token transcription and a measured count.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): V2831 per-page sign transcriptions (trans/v2831p*) and v2831_reading.md; R1098 trans/r1098p1_v.txt/.csv and r1098_reading.md; V267 trans/v267.csv with the clear extract (plaintexts.md, plain267.txt); key.md and key.json. 2831 has sign-by-line notes, not one token file, as Remaining gaps says.

Reading audit (George Lasry's sentence test): v2831_reading.md and r1098_reading.md read through. V2831 p. 1 and p. 2 ll. 1-16 build sentences with scattered holes; p. 2 ll. 17-32 and p. 3 are lines of fragments with [...] in most lines. The V2831 entry split: the second part relabelled decoded, not read; R1098 kept read (reviewed B). fraction_read set to ~0.56 of cipher lines (estimated); class stays read in part.

Re-read brief b25: DECODE key records of Milan 1480s-90s checked: R1099/R1169 = the 1488 Arcimboldo-Oliva key (different: che = ds, a+ = Protonotario). Headings of all 134 ASMi Sforzesco cart. 1597 key records read on contact sheets (research/reading_audit/b25_keysheets.py): no. 111 (DECODE R5411) is headed 'Cum Mapheo Triviliensi', the original key of this cipher (alphabet torn at T-&, doubles, nulls, syllable table, 22-entry nomenclator), transcribed in key_R5411.md; it confirms Somogyi's values where both exist. No. 107 (R5407) 'Cum Mafeo Triviliensi' is a different alphabet.

V2831 p. 2 ll. 17-30 and p. 3 (31 lines) re-transcribed sign by sign from the Vestigia plates with per-row crops (two helper agents, one per page; trans/v2831p2_b25.md, v2831p3_b25.md, corrections tsv). Line counts corrected: p. 2 has 30 lines, p. 3 31.

Both pages re-decoded with R5411: x-bar = Ma (q^s x-bar = Roma, 4 times), M+ = Regina, a# = Vostra Dominatio, Q. = Duca de Milano, Ra = madonna Bianca, + = Vescovo Varadino, fa, bi, pp, rr adopted (each holds at every occurrence). Flagged: the o-form (b by the key, t in most words), delta+ = Papa (sense), g = x in excusar (torn column). Look-alike letters: p. 2 15 (+9 o-form), p. 3 59 of ~1,360.

Partial reading v2831_p2p3_reading.md (English v2831_p2p3_en.md, log v2831_p2p3_reread_log.md). b17_score.py LANG_=it on the body: 0.322 (19/59), explicit holes 0.542; before 0.158 / 0.342. p. 2 ll. 17-27 and half of p. 3 build sentences; the rest fragments. Stays decoded, not read.

v3 verification: R1098 ll. 5-10 re-read sign by sign from native crops with the original key R5411 (n-crossbar tt, reversed d l, crossed b fa, 7 f, 3-with-tail r, looped d s, n# ss, z-stroke e) and aligned with MDE IV no. 91's printed decipherment: 'Tu[ln?]a' was 'tutti li lochi ove ha facto edificare', 'co[si]' 'siamo', '[...]' 'Sua Maiesta mi fece', 'secondo' 'perche lei voleva andare spassando'. r1098_v3_reading.md: 0.917 explicit-hole (was 0.545). trans/r1098p1_v3_corrections.tsv.

v3 verification: V2831 read part (p. 1, p. 2 ll. 1-16, p. 4) rescored on its numbered lines: 0.519 explicit-hole (p. 1 ll. 1-15 0.562, ll. 16-29 0.375, p. 2 ll. 1-16 0.619). No print or contemporary decipherment; the R5411 re-read of these pages not done in this pass. Demoted to decoded, not read.

r2e: V2831 p. 1 (29 lines), p. 2 ll. 1-17 and the p. 4 cipher lines re-transcribed sign by sign from per-row crops of the Vestigia plates with the original key R5411 (trans/v2831p1_r2e.md, v2831p2_r2e.md, v2831p4_r2e.md). p. 2 has 31 lines: its line 1 had never been transcribed. Values adopted at every occurrence: M+ Regina, a# Vostra Dominatio, o+ Imperatore, M-bar Zuan Corvino, x-bar/xo ma, b-crossed fa, b^x ni, n^o pp, n-tail ff; q^o = re (not in the key) holds throughout.

r2e: reading v2831_r2e_reading.md and English aligned word by word with the decodes; 1989 words not carried by the figures withdrawn (etiam twice, havuto, con lo Imperatore). Third pass on b25's lines: 'per [?messere] Francesco fara replicare' (p. 2 ll. 28-29); p. 2 l. 20 and l. 25 no gain; p. 3 not re-cropped.

r2e: v2_score.py (it): p. 1, p. 2 ll. 1-17, p. 4 body 0.642 explicit-hole (34/53; before 0.519), p. 1 ll. 22-29 0.22 under the stain; p. 2 ll. 18-31 + p. 3 0.466. Look-alike letters 0.7%. Share of cipher signs read measured for the first time: 0.847 (358 of 2,338 signs in unread groups). The first part set read (grade B); the second stays decoded, not read.

r2l: 79 unread letter groups of V2831 (research/reading_audit/r2l_buda_raw.txt) turned into lattices of their signs' alternative values (r2l_signs.py) and segmented into words by r2l_seg.py: k-best word segmentation on it-cinquecento corpus word frequencies, ranked by the shared lang/ model it-cinquecento (5-gram) in context. Adopted where the top candidate reads as sense and every letter is carried: ben, in el, epsa, poco amano (p. 1), subiunse, con, li di passati, ha assignati (p. 2), le [?ha] ben, sentire, se ne, le rasone, calumnie, inante, basti (p. 3). About 55 groups give no word under any combination.

r2l: V2831 p. 3 re-cropped from the full-resolution Vestigia plate (3240x4320; r2l_crop3.py, r2l_zoom.py) for L02, L03, L05, L08, L09, L19, L20, L23-L31; 23 label corrections (trans/v2831_r2l_corrections.tsv): dotted q in 'per quanto', su-sign in 'persuadere', Fa in 'facto' and four 'fare', Papa sign twice, 'non [?venga] a alienare l'animo', 'tertio in iustificare' (b25 had counted one sign twice), 'offerendoli de mandarlo li', 'innocentia', 'cosa', 'sento d'avere'.

r2l: v2_score.py (it): p. 2 ll. 18-31 + p. 3 0.636 explicit-hole (35/55; before 0.466), plain 0.491; p. 1, p. 2 ll. 1-17, p. 4 0.698 (before 0.642). Look-alike letters recounted by the brief's definition 1.8% (b25's broad count 4.3%). Second part set read (grade B); class stays read in part (hole rate 0.12, read bar of 95% not met).

Independent second reader (sr) on V2831 p. 2 ll. 18-31 + p. 3: 8 lines drawn with random.seed(20261023) (p. 2 L30; p. 3 L02, L03, L09, L10, L21, L23, L31), signs transcribed blind on per-line crops of the Vestigia plates (3240x4320) and decoded with key_R5411.md, then compared with trans/v2831p2_b25.md, v2831p3_b25.md, trans/v2831_r2l_corrections.tsv and v2831_p2p3_r2l_reading.md (trans/v2831_sr_blind.tsv). Signs 388/416 agree (93.3%); reading words not carried by the blind decode 26/92 (28%), after the second reader's own re-crops of each disputed sign 9/92 (9.8%: sua x2, mando, andisse, arte, et x2, che, Turco).
Read bar applied per document (v10): 1 of 3 documents marked read measure under 95% of words read as sense (v2_score explicit holes) and are now read in part; read_share recorded for each.

outcome.method_basis: Somogyi 2016 published the key of Maffeo da Treviglio's cipher in numeric form; it was tied to the glyphs here by aligning Vestigia 267 with its clear extract 268 and then applied to the 22 Nov 1489 letter and DECODE R1098, gaining some new sign values.
outcome.notes: Read in part since 22 Sept 2026: share of signs read not measured, p. 3 of the 1489 letter after l. 19 in patches. Readings are in gist in places; a few signs unidentified and stained line ends. 'matched control' refers to Somogyi's printed lines 1-2. 22 Oct 2026, reading audit: V2831 split into a read part (p. 1, p. 2 ll. 1-16, p. 4) and a decoded-not-read part (p. 2 ll. 17-32, p. 3); R1098 reviewed B.

gaps.item: V2831 letter groups that decode letter for letter but give no word: p. 1 L03, L04, L08, L11, L12, L17, L19-L22, L25-L29; p. 2 L15, L16, L19-L21, L25, L28-L31 between secure words; p. 3 L02, L03 head, L05-L08 middles, L15, L18, L21, L22, L27, L29, L31; p. 4 L02
gaps.detail: four passes: three sign by sign (b25 twice, r2e with R5411) and r2l (23 Oct 2026) with the lang/ model it-cinquecento as segmenter over every alternative sign value plus a full-resolution re-crop of p. 3; the remaining groups need the values the torn columns of R5411 held (T, U/V, X, Y, Z, &, part of the syllable rows) or signs not in the key (r-ring, the n-stroke in 'ochi aperti', the lone x on p. 3 l. 29)

gaps.item: V2831 p. 3 l. 15, one or two signs under an ink blot
signs whose key column is torn away on R5411 (x, y, z, &, part of t) and r-ring (p. 3 l. 15); the o-form read t in most words but b by the key
gaps.detail: R5411 is torn at the upper right; the o-form value needs review against R1098 and V267

gaps.item: 2831 p. 1 ll. 21-29, last words of each line
gaps.detail: stain at the right edge, no other image (DECODE and Vestigia serve the same negative); re-checked at 3x on 23 Oct 2026 (r2e)

texts.label: Vestigia 2831, Buda 22 Nov 1489: p. 1, p. 2 ll. 1-17 and the two cipher lines of p. 4 (p. 2 has 31 lines)
texts.summary: Maffeo da Treviglio to Ludovico Sforza: King Matthias will not go to the Diet without letters from the Emperor that let him come away justified; the new Neapolitan ambassador is to reconcile the Queen with the King and has raised again the match of John Corvinus with don Federico's daughter, which the King takes as made in spite of the Milanese marriage; courtiers tell messer Francesco he goes to Naples 'to undo what you have cooked'; Maffeo advises that the Queen will spare no effort to turn the King and will not yield 'to the insatiable wrath of Juno'.

reading_review.note: r2e 23 Oct 2026: re-read sign by sign from the Vestigia plates with the original key R5411 (trans/v2831p1_r2e.md, v2831p2_r2e.md, v2831p4_r2e.md); 0.642 explicit-hole, look-alike letters 0.7%, share of cipher signs read 0.847. r2l 23 Oct 2026 (v2831_r2l_reread_log.md): the unread groups segmented with the lang/ model it-cinquecento over the alternative sign values; ben, in el, epsa, poco amano, subiunse adopted (every letter carried); 0.698 explicit-hole (37/53).

texts.note: 24 Oct 2026: 90.2% of the words of v2831_r2e_reading.md read as sense (v2_score explicit holes); coherent sentences but under the 95% read bar, so read in part.

23 Oct 2026: p. 2 ll. 18-31 and p. 3 scored 0.636 on explicit holes after the r2l LM-assisted segmentation, but a blind second reader (8 random lines, seed 20261023, trans/v2831_sr_blind.tsv) found 9 of 92 unbracketed words (9.8%) not supported by the signs after re-checking each on the crops; spread over the unsampled lines that takes the reading under the 0.60 bar. Kept decoded, not read; the partial reading and English stay in v2831_p2p3_r2l_reading.md / _en.md.
texts.label: Vestigia 2831, Buda 22 Nov 1489: p. 2 ll. 18-31 and p. 3 (p. 2 has 31 lines, p. 3 31)
DECODE R1098, Buda 12 Jan 1490
texts.summary: Maffeo to Ludovico Sforza: the King left on the 8th for Vienna, less drawn by hope of the Diet than by his own wish to go; the legate, the other ambassadors and Maffeo have decided to leave on the 15th. Ten cipher lines after a clear passage; the earlier gaps in ll. 5, 6 and 9 were closed on 23 October 2026 by a re-read with key R5411 (r1098_v3_reading.md).

reading_review.note: v3 verification 23 Oct 2026: r1098_reading.md scored 0.545 explicit-hole on its body (0.595 in the sweep). Lines 5-10 re-read from native crops of IMG_R1098_I5648_P1 with the original key R5411 (tutti li lochi, facto, edificare, presto, siamo, fece, andassimo, spassando) and checked against the contemporary decipherment printed in MDE IV no. 91 (Nagy & Nyáry 1878), which fills 'Sua Maiesta mi' and 'perche ... voleva': r1098_v3_reading.md scores 0.917 explicit-hole, 0.75 plain (11/12 sentences).

texts.label: Vestigia 267, Vienna 2 Apr 1490 (calibration letter)
texts.summary: Calibration pair: the cipher letter of 2 Apr 1490 with its contemporary clear extract (Vestigia 268): the Turkish ambassador is still at court and treats, among other things, of a prolongation of the peace.

reading_review.note: Translation wave v9, 23 Oct 2026: V267_reading.md written (clear opening 'Lo', the cipher as given by its contemporary clear extract Vestigia 268, the clear close), checked against the key decode of trans/v267.csv; v2_score.py: plain 0.889 (8/9), explicit holes 1.0 (9/9), hole rate 0.013. English in V267_en.md.

outcome.fraction_read_source: Documents that read / all, counted in cipher lines: V2831 has 93 cipher lines (p. 1 29, p. 2 31, p. 3 31, p. 4 2) and R1098 10, 103 in all; since r2l (23 Oct 2026) every part reads to the 0.60 sentence bar: V2831 p. 1, p. 2 ll. 1-17, p. 4 (0.698 explicit-hole), p. 2 ll. 18-31 and p. 3 (0.636), R1098 (0.917): 103 of 103. Inside the readings the hole rate is 0.106 and 0.121 of words (v2_score.py), and the share of cipher signs read was measured 0.847 for p. 1, p. 2 ll. 1-17 and p. 4 (r2e); the 95% read bar of README Conventions is not met, hence class read in part. V267 (calibration letter with its clear copy) not counted. History: 22 Oct 0.56 (estimated), 23 Oct v3 0.099, r2e 0.563. Revised 23 Oct 2026 after the blind second reading: p. 2 ll. 18-31 and p. 3 back to decoded, not read, so the read lines are again V2831 p. 1, p. 2 ll. 1-17, p. 4 and R1098 (58 of 103 cipher lines).
